verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.vast.ai/llms.txt that returns HTTP 200 and indexes the docs as markdown links. The docs also include a dedicated agents guide, an agent skill installable with one command, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: evidence of the full depth of the llms.txt (e.g. an llms-full.txt or complete coverage), and independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.vast.ai/llms.txt # Vast.ai Documentation: Affordable GPU Cloud Marketplace
A **skill** or **plugin** lets an agent operate your **account** — find, rent, launch, and tear down instances.
Install the skill into your coding agent with one command: npx skills add vast-ai/vast-cli --skill vastai
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.vast.ai/api/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
